liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **banter - inviting dancers**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **banter - inviting George Porter Jr**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **Hey Pocky Way**: back after 25 archived shows (373 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **Will It Go 'Round In Circles**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Hey Pocky Way**: back after 25 archived shows (373 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **How Sweet It Is**: rare: 3 archived performances [7]
- **Just Kissed My Baby**: rare: 11 archived performances [7]
- **banter - inviting the London Souls**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]

## The recordings

- **soulive2013-03-16.mk5-mk21.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 31 songs; 231 min [1]
- **soulive2013-03-16.mk5-mk21.fla24**: audience recording; 31 songs; 231 min [2]
- **soulive2013-03-16.tlm170.flac24**: audience recording; 27 songs; 170 min [5]. Said about its sound: Uploader removed twelve loud nearby claps from set 2, track 16 [5]
- **soulive2013-03-16.tlm170.flac16**: audience recording; 27 songs; 170 min [6]. Said about its sound: Twelve loud nearby claps were removed from set 2, track 16 [6]

## Around the show

- Night 8 of Bowlive IV; the Alecia Chakour Band played the opening set [1]
- Guests included Shady Horns, George Porter Jr. on bass and vocals, the London Souls, and Cochemea Gastelum on tenor sax [1]
- Guests included Shady Horns (Zoidis, Casey, Bloom), George Porter Jr., London Souls, Cochemea Gastelum, and Chris St. Hilaire on percussion [2]
- Tash Neal played guitar and Colin Brown played keys as guests during the evening show [2]
- Alecia Chakour Band opened; this was the final night of the fourth annual Bowlive run [5]
- Eric Krasno sang on one song; guests included Shady Horns, London Souls, Gastelum on sax, and George Porter on bass and vocals [5]
- Alecia Chakour Band opened; this was the final show of the fourth Bowlive run at Brooklyn Bowl [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive2013-03-16.mk5-mk21.flac16**: taped by Eric McRoberts; transferred by Eric McRoberts; source: Audience/On Stage [1]. Also: A 16-bit version of the mk5-mk21 recording; a higher quality 24-bit version is available separately [1]
- **soulive2013-03-16.mk5-mk21.fla24**: taped by Eric McRoberts; transferred by Eric McRoberts; source: Audience/On Stage [2]. Also: This is the 24-bit version of the mk5-mk21 recording, not meant for MP3 streaming or CD burning [2]
- **soulive2013-03-16.tlm170.flac24**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: FOB Audience [5]
- **soulive2013-03-16.tlm170.flac16**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: FOB Audience [6]. Also: Scott Bernstein recorded, mastered, tracked, tagged and posted it in March 2013, with a mic clamped to Mike Buzzeo's stand [6]
